title: 'Ramayana' trailer leaked again, shows Yash's entry as Raavan, netizens urge the makers of the Ranbir Kapoor starrer to drop it officially: 'They should have stronger security measures'
summary: The 'Ramayana' trailer leaked again, reportedly showing Yash as Raavan. Netizens urged the makers of the Ranbir Kapoor starrer to officially release the trailer and strengthen security, criticizing repeated unauthorized leaks that undermine promotional plans.
content:
The trailer for the much-anticipated film Ramayana was leaked again, reportedly showing Yash's entry as Raavan. The leak has prompted intense online reaction, with many netizens calling on the makers of the Ranbir Kapoor starrer to officially release the trailer rather than letting unauthorised copies circulate.

Social media users criticised the production team's security, with comments such as 'They should have stronger security measures' appearing widely. Fans and observers expressed frustration at repeated leaks that undermine marketing plans and the element of surprise around character reveals.
